messages.subject: [R--gR] Plotting in Coxph using psplines
messages.body_plain:
I would like to produce a GAM-like graph in coxph 
when incorporating psplines into a Cox model. 
Basically, I would like to plot the MLE and 95% 
conf. bands as well as obtain a rug plot.
If anyone has such a function, it would be well-appreciated.
